review.notes: The Rs 200 Faisal Handicrafts listing could not be found or verified, and the comparable 12 in 5-piece brass set found wholesale is Rs 800/set (MOQ 10, ExportersIndia) with other Moradabad sets at Rs 350-430 - break-even for 30% at Rs 799 is about Rs 310, so the realistic cost fails (Rs 360 -> 22.5%, Rs 430 -> 12.3%). A Rs 200 set is likely thin/plated, the 'pure brass' claim needs a test report the supplier has not provided, and dents/tarnish add return risk; resubmit only with a verified quote of Rs 300 or less including plate gauge/weight and a material test report.
